## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes with all tests green
- [ ] `pnpm lint` reports zero issues
- [ ] `pnpm build` completes cleanly without chunk size warnings
- [ ] `pnpm content:validate` passes (if modifying curriculum content)
- [ ] Accessibility verified (keyboard navigation and contrast check)
- [ ] Tested on target browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari)
